_readme: Athena Engine project library. Every entry shows up under Library → Models → Project. Drop the .glb next to this file, add a line here, deploy. Y-up, metres, origin at the base. `anims` is optional and only a hint — the editor reads the real clip names from the file. `tags` (optional, short lower-case words) makes the entry findable in the Library search.
_sounds_readme: Project sounds for Athena Engine (Library → Sounds → Project). URLs of files the game already ships — nothing is uploaded. Keep them under 25 MiB (Cloudflare's per-asset cap).
